summary: No dataset of conifer-cone parastichy counts was found: Dryad and DataCite searches returned zero hits and the Zenodo hits are unrelated papers. Image sources exist (GBIF 48,584 Picea abies and 12,803 Larix decidua image records; iDigBio 1,102 Picea abies records) but they were not checked for cones and carry no counts, and MorphoSource has no media under Picea or Larix. Smithsonian Open Access returned HTTP 403.
next_step: Compile a table by hand: sample a few hundred GBIF/iNaturalist cone photographs per species (filtering by a 'cone' keyword in the media description), pre-register the counting protocol, and have two independent counters score the two opposing parastichy families; or collect published counts from the literature.
obstacles_confirmed: Published cone counts are summarised in papers rather than released as one open raw table; no repository record was found.
Image sources are not curated for cones, and herbarium sheets are poor for cone arrangement.
